definitions.ask: After the fix lands, should the implementer propose an immediate release cut that ships sase-core-rs 0.45.0?
definitions.why: a cut happens within a day anyway; a manual cut spends ~75 MB of PyPI quota on your timing

choices.label: Propose the dry_run=false dispatch via /sase_gate; you confirm before anything publishes
Dispatch nothing; the next daily cut or the steward's dispatch proves the fix within a day
